items.summary: Recommendation: reject all new queue and production work this cycle. Retain the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate, keep SearchWoot private, and await attribution reconciliation and recorded measurement thresholds. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 with $4.92 commission, while one tracking ID remains unmapped; no site-level ROI, margin, payback, or forecast claims are supported. Prior implementation attempts also failed and no outcomes are proven. Owner decision: approve waiting for existing measurement and attribution evidence before authorizing further implementation?
